text: Chapter 12: The Weredragons' Vital Point@Intense Battle in the Propulsion System
■Next Mission\Move from Weredragon's Throat to\nTunnel of Trials to start.
After sending Muti back to the surface, go check if there is\nanything wrong in Propulsion System Zone!
There might be something more powerful than the small\ndragons in the Power Converter room waiting for you.\nHead to the Accelerator room in the back!
The most powerful enemy seems to be in the Propulsion System\nRoom. Go there as soon as possible while beating the\ndragon's minions!
The energy of the propulsion system is reversed to get rid\nof Wicked Dragon Fazzino from the tube, but it may explode\nif it is reversed too long. Beat it before that happens!
